name: read-and-report
prompt: Read src/lib.rs and tell me, in one sentence, what the greeting function returns.

name: fix-the-bug
prompt: The tests in this crate fail. Run them, find out why, fix the bug in src/lib.rs, and run the tests again to prove the fix works.

name: add-a-function
prompt: Add a function called `double` to src/lib.rs that returns twice its argument, with a test for it, and run the tests to prove it works.
